verdict.rationale: Riveter documents a hard cap of up to 10,000 rows per /enrich request and SDKs that handle pagination, retries, and long-polling, implying some built-in batching support for large inputs, but there is no explicit mention of an 'intelligent chunking' strategy that automatically splits oversized tables to fit processing limits. missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic table-splitting/chunking logic beyond the row cap, and evidence of handling tables larger than 10,000 rows across multiple linked runs.
